lg_Say_n11001: The Sakura Plains lie shrouded in darkness. Only the strongest ninja can survive this tough challenge.
lg_Say_n11002: To prove your own Strength, go to the arena, even with a few wounds. You will find a real fight there.
lg_Say_n11003: Mythical artifacts of war are forged in this furnace! If you can dream it, I can make it!
lg_Say_n11004: Need gems to make your equipment more beautiful? Need hidden weapons to improve your combat ability? Or food and potions? We have them all.
lg_Say_n11005: Don't miss our collection of weapons and armor. A variety of equipment is available at the best prices.
lg_Say_n11006: Powerful ninja can use other ninja's services free of charge! Want to take on a disciple? You've come to the right person!

lg_Say_n11013: It's no good to stay on standby all the time. Take a look when you're free, you may find some interesting jobs to choose from!
lg_Say_n11014: You can buy high-grade equipment with attributes here using Stone. Want to try your luck?
lg_Say_n11017: It is said the Five Kage are holding a meeting right after the tailed beast raid. Do you want to take a look?
lg_Say_n17001: The spirits of ancient heroes are under the rule of demons. Can you defeat the servants and the emperor to save the manipulated heroic spirits?

lg_TaskTalk100010:
Now that you have the basic mindset of a ninja of the world, it's time to test your ability.
Now go to the Smelting Mountains and kill Sunflowers to begin your journey. We can't go on like this. Do you want to catch Sunflowers?
lg_TaskTalk100011: Good, congratulations on passing the trial. You are not a qualified ninja yet.
lg_TaskTalk100020: Becoming a ninja is not easy. You need to train and take part in keeping the village at peace. Go and meet the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>now.
lg_TaskTalk100021: Protecting the village and the travelers passing through is the mission of the village guard.
lg_TaskTalk100030: Even though we sent people, the<font color='#00b034'> Sunflower </font>calamity continues in the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains</font>. The<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>outpost has asked the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>for help. Go now and help keep the peace in the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100031: Are you one of those sent by the guards? I've been waiting for you for a while.
lg_TaskTalk100040: <font color='#00b034'>Stinger Bees </font>are the hardest to deal with. So many people have been stung already, and to fight them we need to get their stingers. Help me collect some<font color='#00b034'> Venom Stingers</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100041: Thank you for getting the<font color='#00b034'> Venom Stingers</font>. Now I can treat the many suffering travelers.
lg_TaskTalk100050: Thanks to the efforts of the guards, the<font color='#00b034'> Stinger Bees </font>no longer pose a threat to travelers. Return to the village and give the good news to the<font color='#00b034'> Jounin</font>!
lg_TaskTalk100051: The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>clearly didn't pick the wrong person. Your performance on your first quest was excellent, keep working hard.
lg_TaskTalk100060:
With the crisis over, the Village Elder has decided to hold a banquet to celebrate.
Speaking of banquets, we can't leave out sushi, the finest delicacy in all of the Sakura Plains. Just thinking about it makes my mouth water. But for unknown reasons, the Sushi Monsters have stopped producing sushi. Woe to us if we have to live without sushi!
You must find the Sushi Monsters in the Smelting Mountains and get delicious sushi from them for the banquet. This is an important quest, and I trust you won't let me down.
lg_TaskTalk100061: Ahhh! Here it is! The luxurious<font color='#00b034'> Wasabi Sushi Roll</font>! Just its aroma is enough to make a grown man cry tears of joy! To taste such a heavenly delicacy, the villagers will be delighted.
lg_TaskTalk100070: You got the<font color='#00b034'> Wasabi Sushi Roll</font>. Now tell the villagers to join the banquet, the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>has been waiting in the hall.
lg_TaskTalk100071: The villagers have arrived, it's time to have fun at the celebration.
lg_TaskTalk100080:
A series of disturbances has occurred in the Smelting Mountains recently, and it turns out it's not only in the Smelting Mountains. Many disturbances have also happened in the Sakura Plains. All of them are connected to one another.
To confirm the truth, I sent a Genin to investigate in each area. The time to report has come, but the Genin still hasn't arrived. Perhaps he ran into trouble on the road.
Now I need to send an envoy to the Smelting Mountains to investigate, and the Jounin recommended you. This quest is very important, you must give it your best effort.
lg_TaskTalk100081: You're finally here, I need your help!
lg_TaskTalk100090:
After I gathered information, I was attacked on the way home by a group calling themselves the Scarlet gang. So I had to hide here.
Only by wiping out these bandits can we return to the village safely.
lg_TaskTalk100091: The bandit group seems to be taking instructions from someone else to chase me this far. Good riddance.
lg_TaskTalk100100:
You, sent by the Village Elder, must be the scout. Because I was ambushed by bandits, to keep the information from falling into their hands, I let my clever ninja dog escape with it.
